scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Girl Child Protection Scheme-I
other_conditions: Only one girl child per family; the family must have no male child and cannot adopt a male child in the future
One parent must have undergone sterilisation before turning 40 years old
Parents or grandparents must be native of Tamil Nadu by birth or have continuous residence of at least ten years at the time of application
Scheme is also applicable to girl children of Sri Lankan Tamil refugees residing in Tamil Nadu refugee camps
Application must be submitted before the child reaches 3 years of age
benefits_summary: A fixed deposit of ₹50,000 is created for the girl child, renewed after five years with an annual incentive of ₹1,800 from the sixth year, payable at age 18 provided she passes the 10th standard exam.
